required_documents.name: SF424 (R&R) Cover Form
required_documents.details: Standard application cover sheet for higher education institutions and nonprofit applicants.

required_documents.name: Project Summary / Abstract
required_documents.details: Summary of educational goals, target student/faculty audience, and curriculum methodology (max 30 lines).
required_documents.source: PA-27-034-Full-Announcement.html Section IV.2 SF424(R&R) Other Project Information

required_documents.name: Project Narrative
required_documents.details: Two or three sentences on how this educational program benefits public health and biomedical workforce skills.
required_documents.source: PA-27-034-Full-Announcement.html Section IV.2 SF424(R&R) Other Project Information

required_documents.name: Facilities & Other Resources
required_documents.details: Description of classrooms, laboratories, computer infrastructure, and teaching facilities available to participants.
required_documents.source: PA-27-034-Full-Announcement.html Section IV.2 SF424(R&R) Other Project Information

required_documents.name: Senior/Key Person Profiles
required_documents.details: Biographical sketches for Program Director(s) and core instructional faculty (max 5 pages each, Commons ID required).
required_documents.source: PA-27-034-Full-Announcement.html Section IV.2 Senior/Key Person Profile

required_documents.name: R&R Detailed Budget and Justification
required_documents.details: Detailed budget justification covering personnel, curriculum materials, participant support costs, and up to 8% F&A rate.

required_documents.name: Specific Aims
required_documents.details: One page outlining the overarching educational objectives and curriculum development milestones.
required_documents.source: PA-27-034-Full-Announcement.html Section IV.2 PHS 398 Research Plan

required_documents.name: Research Education Program Plan
required_documents.details: Maximum 25 pages uploaded under Research Strategy, detailing Program Design, Faculty, Participants, Evaluation Plan, and Dissemination Plan.
required_documents.source: PA-27-034-Full-Announcement.html Section IV.2 PHS 398 Research Plan

required_documents.name: Institutional Environment and Commitment Letter
required_documents.details: Letter from department chair or dean detailing institutional commitment, space, faculty release time, and resources.
required_documents.source: PA-27-034-Full-Announcement.html Section IV.2 PHS 398 Research Plan

required_documents.name: Plan for Instruction in Responsible Conduct of Research
required_documents.details: Maximum 3 pages detailing format, subject matter, faculty participation, and duration of research ethics training.
required_documents.source: PA-27-034-Full-Announcement.html Section IV.2 PHS 398 Research Plan

required_documents.name: Registrations (SAM.gov, Grants.gov, eRA Commons)
required_documents.details: Active institutional registrations in SAM.gov and Grants.gov, and eRA Commons ID for all Program Directors.

deadlines.when: September 25, 2026, 5:00 p.m. local time of applicant organization
January 25, 2027, 5:00 p.m. local time of applicant organization
May 25, 2027, 5:00 p.m. local time of applicant organization

eligibility.summary: Public and private institutions of higher education, non-profits, for-profit organizations, state and local government agencies. In North Carolina, UNC system universities, Duke, Wake Forest, and NC Community Colleges are eligible.

cost_share.details: This NOFO does not require cost sharing as defined in the NIH Grants Policy Statement.

submission_limits: Applicant organizations may submit more than one application, provided each application is scientifically distinct.
important_notes: Clinical trials are not allowed under this FOA.
Research Education Program Plan has a 25-page limit; exceeding this will cause rejection without review.
Educational activities must be distinct from ongoing departmental T32 training grants.
